source: Ported from agent-lab .devcontainer/bootstrap-linux.sh (node, uv, gh, codex, claude) plus fresh 2026-09-22 fetches for qmd, mcporter, rtk, ai-memory, context-mode. Each archive was downloaded into a disposable worktree temp directory and hashed with sha256sum; npm entries were additionally cross-checked against `npm view <pkg> dist.integrity` (sha512, base64) computed with `openssl dgst -sha512 -binary | base64` over the same downloaded tarball -- all five matched exactly.

Later token-profile qualification: Official @openai/codex0.159.2 wrapper archive4904 bytes; SHA256 and npm published SHA512 integrity verified. Clean supported npm prefix installed and was removed; npm audit signatures passed for the platform dependency with official provenance after a retained wrong-cwd failure. This does not independently assert wrapper signature acceptance. Source rust-v0.159.2 ff6aec96948b70d94983af2641a6b67c94faeff5. Native installed client and twelve useful token-tool calls qualified on the existing host; native sign-ins are retained. See token-lifecycle-resolution-20260930 and token-profile-completion-20260930.

minimum version; native auto-update on the latest channel. Raised from 2.1.281 (56fe3da88458465fb27d7e9299dddb3fead55750fb9c2de795f233b5eea6dce1, that release's manifest.json platforms.linux-x64.checksum fetched 2026-09-24, size 237375560; its binary was not re-downloaded or re-hashed) in step with the macOS pin, since shared components keep one version on both platforms: 2.1.284 is the first release whose `sonnet` alias resolves to Sonnet 5.5 (`claude-sonnet-5-5`; CHANGELOG.md 2.1.284: "Added Claude Sonnet 5.5 (`claude-sonnet-5-5`), now the default Sonnet model on the Anthropic API"; https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config lists `sonnet` as Sonnet 5.5 from v2.1.284 and Sonnet 5 from v2.1.197, both read 2026-09-29), so an older client routes `sonnet` to Sonnet 5 on the Anthropic API; the 2.1.281 fix for a recursive rm of command-substitution output running unprompted in auto and --dangerously-skip-permissions mode stays included. This sha256 is the 2.1.284 manifest.json's platforms.linux-x64.checksum (https://downloads.claude.ai/claude-code-releases/2.1.284/manifest.json, fetched 2026-09-29: commit 2b8ce618c24de26410e4bdfc4e1d592accd61f61, buildDate 2026-09-28T02:36:51Z, size 243059896). First independent byte check, without a download: the 2.1.284 linux-x64 binary that Claude Code's own native updater had already installed on the NativeStack WSL2 host (~/.local/share/claude/versions/2.1.284, 243059896 bytes) re-hashes to the same digest (2026-09-29). Also re-hashed on 2026-09-29: the binary streamed from this pin's URL (HTTP 200, 243059896 bytes) hashes to the same digest. The manifest itself was verified with the documented procedure (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/setup#binary-integrity-and-code-signing) on 2026-09-29: the key at https://downloads.claude.ai/keys/claude-code.asc, imported into an empty keyring, has the documented fingerprint 31DD DE24 DDFA B679 F42D 7BD2 BAA9 29FF 1A7E CACE, and `gpg --verify manifest.json.sig manifest.json` reported `Good signature from "Anthropic Claude Code Release Signing <security@anthropic.com>"` (gpg's untrusted-key warning is expected; a copy of the manifest with one byte changed failed with BAD signature). The key's own certification, expiry and revocation were not checked, and the fingerprint comes from the same documentation. fetch() still verifies the served bytes against this sha256 before anything runs. Superseded the prior npm-wrapper pin (2.1.278, DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER=1) once the native installer became the reference path: fetch the binary, verify its sha256, then run `"$bin" install 2.1.284`, matching ~/codex-ecosystem/bin/bootstrap-linux.sh's own claude-code step. The installed binary self-manages ~/.local/share/claude/versions and the ~/.local/bin/claude launcher and auto-updates on the latest channel from there; this pin is a floor, not a ceiling: adoption/bootstrap-linux.sh's install_native (identical to bootstrap-macos.sh's since 2026-09-24) keeps a ~/.local/bin/claude whose --version already reports 2.1.284 or newer, logging `Kept installed claude-code <version>` with nothing downloaded or installed, and runs the checksum-verified install only when that launcher is missing, older or unreadable, so re-running the bootstrap never moves a newer auto-updated install back to this pin. No DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER opt-out is set. Source-host native2.1.285 was reinstalled and qualified2026-09-30; this floor remains2.1.284. See token-lifecycle-resolution-20260930 and token-profile-completion-20260930.

2026-09-25 addition to complete the `token-efficiency` profile's Linux pin coverage. Upstream's pyproject.toml declares `version = "2.0.0.dev0"` with no corresponding PyPI release of that dev version (confirmed reading it at this commit, and the PyPI distribution name is `serena-agent`, not `serena`), so this pin is a source pin: an exact 40-hex commit on oraios/serena (confirmed present with `git cat-file -e c6fbd1c5932df2494ffa0020af5a9fbe80b82143^{commit}` and via the GitHub commits API, both 2026-09-25), not a downloaded-archive sha256. `sha256` is null; `tests/test_adoption_bootstrap.py`'s pin-hash test accepts a null sha256 here only because `kind` is `uv-tool-from-git` and `commit` is a verified 40-hex string -- every other kind still fails closed on a null sha256 exactly as before. The new `uv-tool-from-git` kind's `install_uv_tool_from_git` runs `uv tool install --python 3.13 git+https://github.com/oraios/serena@c6fbd1c5932df2494ffa0020af5a9fbe80b82143` -- the same commit and command already in adoption/bootstrap.md step 4a and recipes/README.md's `serena` row -- into the same `UV_TOOL_DIR`/`UV_TOOL_BIN_DIR` layout `install_uv_tool` uses, then reads back the resulting `uv-receipt.toml` and refuses (exit 1) unless it records this exact commit, so a stale prior install of a different revision can never pass silently. `serena --version` (a Click `is_eager` option that exits before any subcommand runs, confirmed reading src/serena/cli.py at this commit) printed exactly `Serena 2.0.0.dev0` with no `-<commit>` suffix from a fresh, non-editable install (its version helper in src/serena/__init__.py appends one only when its own installed directory is itself a git checkout, which a `uv tool install` from a git source is not); confirmed directly 2026-09-25 in an isolated `UV_TOOL_DIR`/`UV_TOOL_BIN_DIR` scratch install, not the shared host copy.

version_probe.note: No argument parsing at all: every invocation, --help and --version included, starts its MCP stdio server (dist/index.js never reads process.argv; observed 2026-09-25 with socraticode 1.14.0, matching the macOS pin's own note, and 1.15.0's dist/index.js still reads none), so the package version is read from npm metadata instead. Never run `socraticode --version` or with no arguments on a real install -- it starts the server.
